# DAS Digital

> DAS Digital helps small businesses with website design, AI receptionists, business automation and technology consulting. Based in West Palm Beach, Florida, serving Palm Beach, Broward and Miami-Dade counties. Founded in 1989 as DAS Consulting Services by David Spatz.

- Phone: (954) 673-3041
- Email: info@dasdigitalai.com
- Website: https://dasdigitalai.com
- AI receptionists can answer callers in English or Spanish.
- Plain-language help for owners of local businesses such as HVAC companies, plumbers, electricians, roofers, landscapers, restaurants and shops.

## Services

- [Website Design](https://dasdigitalai.com/website-design): fast, phone-friendly small business websites that make it easy to call, book and find the business on Google.
- [Online Store Setup](https://dasdigitalai.com/online-store): online stores for small businesses with integrated card payments and secure checkout, shipping or pickup, order alerts, and products listed on Google and Facebook; offered as the Online Store Starter Package for $995.
- [AI Receptionists](https://dasdigitalai.com/ai-receptionist): answers calls 24/7, takes the caller's details, flags urgent calls and texts the owner right away; from $199 a month plus a one-time $499 setup.
- [Pricing](https://dasdigitalai.com/pricing): month-to-month plans. AI Receptionist Starter $199/month or Pro $349/month (Pro adds lead qualifying, booking, lead tracking and an AI email responder; plus a one-time setup fee); Local Visibility Essentials $349/month or Growth $749/month (one-time $299 setup); Local SEO Setup one-time Basic $299, Standard $499 or Premium $799; Sales Dashboard $149/month plus a $750 one-time build; Paperwork Automation from $1,500; Main Street Bundle (AI Receptionist Starter + Local Visibility Essentials) $499/month.
- [Business Automation](https://dasdigitalai.com/ai-automation-small-business): automatic follow-ups, reminders, lead tracking, texts and payment links.
- [Technology Consulting](https://dasdigitalai.com/technology-consulting): straight advice on which software, phone and point-of-sale tools to keep, replace or connect.
- [Automation and AI consultant in Florida](https://dasdigitalai.com/automation-consultant-florida): local help for South Florida businesses.
- [Custom SaaS development](https://dasdigitalai.com/custom-saas-development): vertical software for small industries.
- [Sales tools for merchant services teams](https://dasdigitalai.com/merchant-services-sales-tools)

## Research

- [AI for small business: statistics and ROI calculator](https://dasdigitalai.com/ai-statistics): sourced figures on small business AI adoption, time saved, missed calls, lead response time and online reviews (U.S. Chamber of Commerce, Goldman Sachs, U.S. Census Bureau, Thryv, Invoca, Harvard Business Review, BrightLocal), plus a calculator for the return on an AI receptionist or better search visibility.

## By trade

- [Automation by trade](https://dasdigitalai.com/automation): HVAC companies, plumbers, electricians, roofers, landscapers, boutiques and hospitality businesses (restaurants, hotels, event venues).
